title: Grateful Dead Live at Community War Memorial Auditorium on 1985-11-07
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi CR-5A > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab 2448 > CD-Wave (24bit output) > TLH > FLAC 2448 tagged. Taped and transferred by Andrew F. 04/2014
source: AUD: Nakamichi CM300/CP4 shotguns > Sony TC-D5M > Maxell MX-90s, with no Dolby. Set up to the right (stage left) of the SBD.

ai_review.summary: Fantastic‑sounding tape of a classic ’85 show, highlighted by standout drum solo breakouts.
ai_review.review: The new source for this 1985 recording is praised as “fantastic sounding,” delivering clear audio despite the tape having been used many times. Reviewers especially love the Drumz and the special breakout jams that make this show a go‑to performance from that year.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one detailed, positive review (4 stars) highlights both excellent audio quality and strong musical moments, leading to a solid but not exceptional rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: New source transfer is described as fantastic sounding; tape shows wear from repeated use but remains clear and enjoyable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The performance flows well, with the drum solos and breakout jams providing energetic peaks that define the show.

band_member_comments.Drums: Drum solos (Drumz) are highlighted as special breakouts and a major highlight of the performance.
